latestRelease.title: Version 9.6.15: The Journal Page Keeps Its Shape

items.description: The reflection box on the journal page now holds a fixed writing area. A long entry used to stretch the page taller and taller, pushing the footer and the page-turn controls out of view; the text now scrolls inside the box instead.
A short entry still fills the page as before, so the open-book spread keeps its proportions on an ordinary day.
